evidence_chain.derivation: Read-only CSV/JSON parsing; cost values divided by 1e6 for the axis only; no manual values

visual_findings: Rolling RegionA, RegionB and RegionC have exactly the same (0 MW, 0 million CNY) coordinate and their RA/RB/RC labels are emitted at exactly the same SVG x/y position, so the labels are not readable as three regions.

The peak-price and high-carbon scenario rows are numerically coincident for each region, and low-renewable and joint-stress rows are numerically coincident for each region; drawing the same triangle marker in sequence hides one member of each pair.
All four scenario classes use the same triangle marker and differ only by color, which fails the required non-color secondary encoding in grayscale.
The source script uses 7 pt region labels, legend text and scope annotation (lines 199 and 248 of the merged generator), below the contract minimum of 8 pt.
The contract declares collision_checked=true, but the generator has no layout collision QA; the emitted SVG confirms the zero-coordinate label collision.

required_repairs.title: Resolve exact-coordinate label and marker overlap
required_repairs.evidence: The emitted SVG places RA, RB and RC at exactly the same x=78.841117 and y=230.522086. Scenario pairs also share exact coordinates, so one triangle hides its mate.
required_repairs.repair: Use deterministic label offsets or leader lines for zero-coordinate regions, and use offset/hollow paired markers or direct pair labels for coincident scenario rows without changing data coordinates. Re-run collision QA and record the result in the Figure Contract.
